riot: This creature enters the battlefield with your choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste.
ripple: When you cast this spell, you may reveal the top N cards of your library. You may cast spells with the same name as this spell from among those cards without paying their mana costs. Put the rest on the bottom of your library.
role-token: A Role is an Aura enchantment token. If a creature already has a Role you control, the old one goes to the graveyard.
rulebreaker: A deck with this commander may break the listed deck-construction rule.
saddle: Tap any number of other creatures you control with total power N or more: This Mount becomes saddled until end of turn. Saddle only as a sorcery.
scavenge: Pay the scavenge cost and exile this card from your graveyard: Put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to this card's power on target creature. Scavenge only as a sorcery.
scry: Look at the top N cards of your library. Put any number of them on the bottom of your library in any order and the rest on top in any order.
secret-council: Each player secretly votes, then the votes are revealed.
seek: Choose a random card matching the condition from your library and put it into your hand (digital only).
shadow: This creature can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.
shroud: This permanent can't be the target of spells or abilities.
skulk: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.
slivercycling: Pay the cycling cost, discard this card: Search your library for a Sliver card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
sneak: You may cast this spell for its sneak cost if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step. It enters tapped and attacking.
solved: This Case's solved ability works once its 'to solve' condition has been met at the beginning of your end step.
soulbond: When this creature enters the battlefield, you may pair it with another unpaired creature you control. They remain paired for as long as you control both of them.
soulshift: When this creature dies, you may return target Spirit card with mana value N or less from your graveyard to your hand.
specialize: Pay the specialize cost and discard a card: Turn this creature into its specialized version matching the discarded card's color. Specialize only as a sorcery.
spectacle: You may cast this spell for its spectacle cost rather than its mana cost if an opponent lost life this turn.
spell-mastery: Bonus if there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.
splice: As you cast a spell of the named type, you may reveal this card from your hand and pay its splice cost. If you do, add this card's effects to that spell.
split-second: As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.
spree: Choose one or more modes and pay the additional cost for each.
squad: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may pay the squad cost any number of times. When this creature enters, create that many tokens that are copies of it.
start-your-engines: If you have no speed, it starts at 1. It increases once on each of your turns when an opponent loses life. Max speed is 4.
station: Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It gains abilities at the listed charge thresholds.
storied: If you control three or more artifacts, legendaries, and/or Sagas, you have an enduring story for the rest of the game.
storm: When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.
strive: This spell costs more for each target beyond the first.
sunburst: This permanent enters with a +1/+1 counter (or charge counter if it isn't a creature) for each color of mana spent to cast it.
support: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N other target creatures.
surge: You may cast this spell for its surge cost if you or a teammate has cast another spell this turn.
surveil: Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.
survival: Triggers at the beginning of your second main phase if this creature is tapped.
suspect: A suspected creature has menace and can't block.
suspend: Rather than cast this card from your hand, you may pay its suspend cost and exile it with N time counters. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, cast it without paying its mana cost.
swampcycling: Pay the cycling cost, discard this card: Search your library for a Swamp card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
swampwalk: This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.
sweep: Return any number of lands of the named type you control to their owner's hand; the effect scales with how many.
teamwork: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap any number of creatures you control with total power N or more for its teamwork bonus.
tempting-offer: Each opponent may also take the offer. For each opponent who does, you get the effect again.
threshold: Bonus if seven or more cards are in your graveyard.
tiered: Choose one tier and pay its additional cost as you cast this spell.
time-travel: For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.
toxic: Players dealt combat damage by this creature also get N poison counters.
training: Whenever this creature attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
trample: Excess damage dealt by this creature can be assigned to the defending player or planeswalker.
trance: A labeled ability of Terra cards; the effect follows the ability word.
transfigure: Pay the transfigure cost and sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a creature card with the same mana value, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Transfigure only as a sorcery.
transform: Turn this permanent over to its other face.
transmute: Pay the transmute cost, discard this card: Search your library for a card with the same mana value as this card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Transmute only as a sorcery.
treasure: A Treasure is an artifact token with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color."
tribute: As this creature enters, an opponent of your choice may put N +1/+1 counters on it. If they don't, its tribute effect triggers.
typecycling: Pay the cycling cost, discard this card: Search your library for a card of the named type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
umbra-armor: If enchanted creature would be destroyed, instead remove all damage from it and destroy this Aura.
undaunted: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each opponent.
undergrowth: Counts the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
undying: When this creature dies, if it had no +1/+1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
unearth: {Cost}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.
unleash: You may have this creature enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. It can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it.
valiant: Triggers whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn.
vanishing: This permanent enters with N time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from it. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.
venture-into-the-dungeon: Enter the first room of a dungeon or advance to the next room, getting that room's effect.
vigilance: This creature doesn't tap when attacking.
vivid: Counts the number of colors among permanents you control (digital only).
void: Bonus at the beginning of your end step if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
ward: Whenever this permanent becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless that player pays the ward cost.
warp: You may cast this card from your hand for its warp cost. If you do, exile it at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.
waterbend: While paying a waterbend cost, you can tap your artifacts and creatures to help. Each one pays for {1}.
web-slinging: You may cast this spell for its web-slinging cost if you also return a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand.
will-of-the-council: Starting with you, each player votes; the option with the most votes happens.
will-of-the-planeswalkers: Starting with you, each player votes for planeswalk or chaos. If planeswalk gets more votes, planeswalk; otherwise chaos ensues.
wither: This deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.
wizardcycling: Pay the cycling cost, discard this card: Search your library for a Wizard card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
